div.head: IV As 4
div.ab: Et qui alterius hominem suscipiet (recipiet) intra mercam uel extra, quem pro malo suo dimittat et castigare non possit, reddat regi centum uiginti solidos et redeat intus unde exiuit et rectum faciat ei cui seruiuit antea.

[De illo qui alterius hominem recepit.] [Q/Br] Et qui alterius hominem suscipiet intra mercam vel extra, quem pro malo suo dimittat et castigare non possit, reddat regi centum viginti solidos, et redeat intus unde exivit, et rectum faciat ei cui servivit antea.

If anyone shall receive a man who has been in the service of another, within or beyond the border, and whom the latter has dismissed for his wrongdoing, and whom he has not been able to punish, he shall pay 120 shillings to the king, and the fugitive shall return to the place from which he came and render satisfaction to him in whose service he has been.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Liebermann compares V As 1; III As 4.
